metadata.description: Dev10x plugin marketplace — structured workflows for commits, PRs, tickets, QA, and more

plugins.name: dev10x
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 17 skills: the core every Dev10x plugin needs (setup, permissions, friction diagnosis, playbooks, both MCP servers and the safety hooks).

plugins.name: dev10x-qa
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 6 skills for self-QA walkthroughs: Playwright capture, narration, evidence publishing, YouTube upload, and review packs.

plugins.name: dev10x-infra
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 2 skills for read-only infrastructure access: AWS secrets and Kubernetes inspection through aws-vault.

plugins.name: dev10x-db
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 3 skills for read-only database work: query planning, a validated psql wrapper, and SQL handoff for changes a person runs.

plugins.name: dev10x-comm
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 7 skills for team and session messaging: Slack and Google Chat notifications, the gog Workspace CLI, the local session bus, Overwatch, and voice supervision.

plugins.name: dev10x-herdr
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 1 skill for Herdr: mission control that coordinates worktree sessions through each repository's main-checkout session.

plugins.name: dev10x-teach
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 7 skills for skill management: create, audit and index skills, file audit findings upstream, and keep context and memory lean.

plugins.name: dev10x-tasks
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 8 skills for task management: track session tasks, sync the plan mirror, park and rediscover deferred work, wrap up a session and reflect its lessons into a vault.

plugins.name: dev10x-scoping
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 19 skills for tickets and scoping: create and scope tickets on GitHub, Linear or JIRA, draft Job Stories, estimate, record and evaluate ADRs, keep specs in sync, and draw diagrams.

plugins.name: dev10x-coding
plugins.description: v0.117.0.dev0 — 40 skills for coding: structured commits, PR lifecycle, branch hygiene, code review, test runs, and the work-on, fanout and foreman orchestrators.
